WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as overall_avg
  FROM fees f 
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
),
pair_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as avg_net_fee
  FROM fees f 
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY COALESCE(o.mktnote, 'NULL_PAIR')
)
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN pa.avg_net_fee > oa.overall_avg THEN pa.avg_net_fee END) as mean_of_avg_net_fees,
  AVG(CASE WHEN pa.avg_net_fee > oa.overall_avg THEN pa.avg_net_fee - oa.overall_avg END) as mean_excess
FROM pair_avgs pa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
